clauses.standard_text: Subscription renews automatically for successive 1-year terms unless either party gives written notice of non-renewal at least 30 days before the end of the then-current term.
Customer may cancel at any time effective at the end of the current billing period. No cancellation fees apply.
Provider may increase fees on renewal with at least 60 days' notice; increases shall not exceed 7% per renewal term.
Provider guarantees 99.9% monthly uptime, with service credits of 10% of monthly fees for each 0.1% below the threshold.
Provider's aggregate liability shall not exceed fees paid by Customer in the 12 months preceding the claim.
Customer data shall be retained for 30 days after termination for export, after which it shall be deleted.
